important_instructions: Internship, Training, Apprenticeship, and Teaching Period will not be counted as experience. All qualifications must be regular and full-time from Indian Universities/Institutes recognized by AICTE or appropriate statutory authorities. Candidates working in Govt./PSU must forward applications through proper channel or produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the time of Personal Interview. Candidates employed with Government Departments, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must submit a relieving letter from their current organization at the time of joining. Private sector candidates must mandatorily submit Form 16 for FY 24-25 and FY 25-26 along with a CTC certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure A). Candidates must bring a valid photo ID to the interview; photocopies are not acceptable. Keep your registered email ID and mobile number active for at least one year as all communications will be via email or SMS. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.

Minimum 13 years of post-qualification experience in Executive/ Officer cadre in the area of Accounts/ Finance/ Internal Audit (for Finance) or Human Resource and Industrial Relation (for HR) preferably in Public Sector Organizations/ Central Government/ State Government/ Large Private Sector organization of repute. Deputy General Manager (Finance / HR): Post qualification Executive experience of 17 years in Executive/Officer cadre, out of which at least 2 years in the immediate lower grade / scale IDA: 90,000 – 3% - 2,40,000 Equivalent level (private sector): Rs. 23 lacs p.a CTC. Minimum 17 years of post-qualification experience in Executive/ Officer cadre in the area of Accounts/ Finance/ Internal Audit (for Finance) or Human Resource and Industrial Relation (for HR) preferably in Public Sector Organizations/ Central Government/ State Government/ Large Private Sector organization of repute. Additional General Manager (Finance / HR): Post qualification Executive experience of 21 years in Executive/Officer cadre, out of which at least 2 years in the immediate lower grade / scale IDA: 1,00,000 – 3% - 2,60,000 Equivalent level (private sector): Rs. 26 lacs p.a CTC. Minimum 21 years of post-qualification experience in Executive/ Officer cadre in the area of Accounts/ Finance/ Internal Audit (for Finance) or Human Resource and Industrial Relation (for HR) preferably in Public Sector Organizations/ Central Government/ State Government/ Large Private Sector organization of repute.

content_sections.heading: THDC Selection Process
content_sections.text: The marks obtained in Personal Interview will be taken as a basis for drawing final merit and empanelling the candidates for selection. No candidate securing overall less than 50% marks will be empanelled. Empanelment will be made in order of merit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for THDC Recruitment
content_sections.text: Go to the THDC website career section at the official link. Fill in your Basic Information and enter your name as mentioned in your Xth Marksheet certificate. Complete the fields for State Domicile, Category, Religion, Academics, Professional Qualification, Languages Known, and Address details. Fill in your experience details with proper mention of the period of service. Upload all required scanned documents in the specified formats and sizes. For General, OBC(NCL), and EWS candidates, click on 'Make Payment' to pay the registration fee of Rs. 600/- via SBIePay, check auto-fetched payment details, and click Submit. For ST/SC/PwBDs / Ex-Servicemen / Doob Kshetra / Departmental Candidates, directly click on the Submit button for Final Submission as no fee is required. Take a print out of the completed application form and keep it safely for future reference. Do not send printouts by post.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Scanned passport size color photograph with white background (Size: 50 KB, Format: JPG/PNG) Scanned signature in black ink against white background (Size: 20 KB, Format: JPG/PNG) Class Xth and XIIth Marksheet (Size: 125 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) Marksheet & Degree (Full-Time/Regular) of essential qualification along with additional qualifications if any as one file (Size: 500 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) Experience Certificate clearly mentioning the period of service and designation as one file (Size: 1 MB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) Caste / Category / PwBD / J&K Domiciled / Ex-Servicemen / Victims of riots / Doob Kshetra Certificate in Government of India format (Size: 125 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) Proof of norms adopted by University/Institute to convert CGPA/OGPA/DGPA into percentage or marksheet if CGPA is not applicable (Size: 125 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) Form 16 of Previous Employer of FY 2024-2025 and FY 2025-26 for private sector candidates (Size: 500 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) Payslips for Sep 2024, Sep 2025, and Sep 2026 as one file (Size: 500 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) CTC certificate duly signed and issued by Employer of FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26 as per Annexure-A (Size: 500 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF)

content_sections.heading: THDC Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Internship, Training, Apprenticeship, and Teaching Period will not be counted as experience. All qualifications must be regular and full-time from Indian Universities/Institutes recognized by AICTE or appropriate statutory authorities. Candidates working in Govt./PSU must forward applications through proper channel or produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the time of Personal Interview. Candidates employed with Government Departments, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must submit a relieving letter from their current organization at the time of joining. Private sector candidates must mandatorily submit Form 16 for FY 24-25 and FY 25-26 along with a CTC certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure A). Candidates must bring a valid photo ID to the interview; photocopies are not acceptable. Keep your registered email ID and mobile number active for at least one year as all communications will be via email or SMS. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.

faq.question: Q1. What is THDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: THDC Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification (Advt. No. 06/2026) issued by THDC India Limited to recruit 10 regular vacancies for Senior Manager, Deputy General Manager, and Additional General Manager positions in Finance and HR disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in THDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies available across Senior Manager, Deputy General Manager, and Additional General Manager posts in Finance and HR.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for THDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 6 November 2026 up to 06:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for THDC Finance posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be CA or CMA qualified from The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or The Institute of Cost Accountants of India, along with required post-qualification executive experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for THDC HR posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a full-time MBA with HRM specialization (HR as main or major subject) / HRD / HRM with minimum 60% marks, or a Post Graduate Degree / 2-year full-time Post Graduate Diploma in Personnel Management/IR/Labour Welfare with minimum 60% marks, or Masters in Social Work or MHROD, plus required post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for Senior Manager posts in THDC?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Senior Manager (Finance and HR) posts is 48 years as on 07.10.2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for THDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General, OBC (NCL), and EWS candidates must pay an application fee of Rs. 600/- online. SC, ST, PwBDs, Ex-Servicemen, Departmental candidates, and Doob Kshetra / Project Affected Area families are exempt from the fee.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for THDC Manager positions?
faq.answer: Candidates are selected based on marks obtained in a Personal Interview, which is used for drawing the final merit list.

faq.question: Q9. What is the pay scale for Additional General Manager (E-8 Grade)?
faq.answer: The pay scale for Additional General Manager in E-8 Grade is Rs. 1,20,000 - 3% - 2,80,000.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates apply for THDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official career portal of THDC India Limited at www.thdc.co.in.
